lede: Beech Grove celebrates Christmas with a lighted parade down Main Street, Santa and Mrs. Claus at the senior center, Santa meals at Napoli Villa and a Polar Express story time at Moonlit Vine Bookstore.
celebrates: The City of Beech Grove kicks off the season with its Lighted Christmas Parade on Main Street on Saturday, December 5, with a 6 pm start. Santa and Mrs. Claus then visit the Beech Grove Senior Center on December 19. Napoli Villa serves Pasta with Santa on December 6 and a Brunch with Santa on December 13, and Moonlit Vine Bookstore reads Polar Express stories on December 19. Each listing on this page links to the host, so you can check times, tickets and seating before you go.
lastyear: Beech Grove's Christmas parade took place on Saturday, December 6, 2025, at 6 pm, according to Mirror Indy and WISH-TV, with the parade stepping off from Main Street and 10th Avenue. WISH-TV reported that the city paired its Christmas season kickoff with a Polar Express event that same week. The 2026 parade moves to Saturday, December 5, and the city calendar has again posted it as a free event for families.
facts: The Beech Grove Promoters Club's event listing places the parade route on Main Street from 10th Street to 6th Avenue. Beech Grove is an independent city surrounded by Indianapolis in Marion County, so its holiday events are separate from the Indianapolis city calendar. Napoli Villa runs two different Santa meals three weeks apart, a pasta dinner with two seatings on December 6 and a brunch on December 13, which gives families a choice of evening or morning.
trains: The closest Christmas train for families is the Nickel Plate Express in Noblesville, which boards at Forest Park and runs themed excursions, including a holiday train, on 12 miles of the former Nickel Plate Road. The Indiana Transportation Museum ran trains from the same park from 1960 to 2018, and Rally has a page on what happened to it. The Whitewater Valley Railroad in Connersville has paused its main line trains after the 2026 flood but still runs motorcar rides and special trips. Check each host's schedule before you drive.

faq: When is the Beech Grove Christmas parade in 2026?
The Beech Grove Lighted Christmas Parade is Saturday, December 5, 2026, on Main Street, with a 6 pm start according to the city's event listing. Watching is free.
Where can kids meet Santa in Beech Grove?

Santa and Mrs. Claus visit the Beech Grove Senior Center on December 19, and Napoli Villa hosts Pasta with Santa on December 6 and Brunch with Santa on December 13. Each listing on this page has the details.
Are there free Christmas events in Beech Grove?
The Lighted Christmas Parade is free. Napoli Villa's Santa meals are ticketed, and the Senior Center listing does not print a price, so check with the host.
Is there a Polar Express event in Beech Grove?
Moonlit Vine Bookstore holds a Polar Express story time on Saturday, December 19, from 11 to 11:30 am. The listing on this page shows its current ticket status.
